name: Story complications
description: Oracle-style complications and an action and subject pair for inspiration.

tables.name: Complication
tables.description: Roll when a scene needs a twist or the oracle says "but".
rows: An ally has their own agenda here, and it is not yours
Someone arrives who should not be here
The price turns out to be higher than agreed
It is a trap, but not for you
A secret comes out at the worst moment
Equipment breaks, runs out or goes missing
An old enemy hears where you are
Time runs short; something must be left behind
A bystander is hurt or in danger
The information was wrong, or half true
Two goals you care about collide
Someone asks for a favour you cannot easily refuse
A rival reaches the goal first
Someone you trust lies to you
Help arrives, and brings its own trouble
The target is not who you thought
An illness or injury flares up
A promise made long ago comes due
The thing you seek is already damaged or changed
Nature intrudes: a flood, a fire, a hungry animal
Someone offers a better deal to your enemy
A messenger brings news that changes everything
It is much quieter than it should be
